title: docsite manifest
description: docsite/manifest.json — the routing and identity declaration for i.commitwork.online. slug and urlPath are IDENTITY: a urlPath never rotates on save or rebuild (capability URLs live in readers' bookmarks and history); only bin/docsite-new.mjs may mint one. kind 'md' entries are built from content/<slug>.md by bin/docsite-build.mjs; kind 'imported' entries are byte-exact snapshots under imported/ and are never rewritten by the build. state governs the publish bundle: draft = local only, hidden = deployed but unlisted, published = deployed and listed in the index/nav. Consumed at LOAD by lib/docsite-manifest.mjs, which validates before returning — a manifest that fails validation is an error, never an empty doc list.

alias.description: A readable public path served INSTEAD of urlPath, with urlPath kept as a 301 into it. urlPath stays the identity key and never rotates; the alias is presentation. Adding one is safe for existing links (they redirect); CHANGING one is not, and orphans every link handed out under the old alias.

label.description: An editorial statement about the CONTENT, shown on the index in place of the build-freshness badge. Deliberately separate from `state` and from freshness: state is where the document deploys, freshness is whether the built HTML is current with its source, and label is how finished the writing is. A byte-fresh build of a draft is still a draft, and collapsing the three would make one of those questions unanswerable.
